title: SDG 14 保育海洋生態
footer: Teacher Dom · SDG #14 Life Below Water 保育海洋生態

slides.eyebrow_en: The ocean is closer than you think

strip.en: of your oxygen is from the sea
strip.zh: 你呼吸的氧氣來自海洋

slides.head_en: I grew up beside the Pacific Ocean.

lines.en: In California, the sea was at the end of my street.
lines.zh: 在加州，走到街底就是海。

lines.en: I thought Taiwan would feel far from the ocean.
lines.zh: 我以為台灣會離海很遠。

lines.en: Then I looked at a map of Changhua.
lines.zh: 後來我看了彰化的地圖。

slides.ask_en: Put up your hand — how many of you have seen the sea this year?
slides.ask_zh: 舉手看看——今年看過海的有多少人？

slides.ask_en: Everything between my home and yours is ocean. It is one ocean, not two.
slides.ask_zh: 我家和你家之間全部都是海。那是同一片海，不是兩片。

prompts.en: Stand up if you have eaten oysters.
Stay standing if you have been to the Changhua coast.
prompts.zh: 去過彰化海邊的，繼續站著。

prompts.en: Stay standing if you have ever picked up litter on a beach.
prompts.zh: 曾經在海邊撿過垃圾的，繼續站著。

slides.punch_en: Look around. Those oysters grew 27 km from this classroom.
slides.punch_zh: 看看四周。你吃的那些蚵仔，就長在離這間教室 27 公里的地方。

slides.head_en: from your school to the sea
slides.body_en: Tianwei is inland — but Fangyuan is less than an hour away by car.
slides.body_zh: 田尾是內陸鄉，但開車到芳苑不用一小時。
slides.ask_en: Does living inland mean the ocean is not your problem?
slides.ask_zh: 住在內陸，海洋就不關你的事嗎？

slides.head_en: The River Runs Past Your School
slides.head_zh: 那條溪，就從你們學校旁邊流過
slides.body_en: The Dongluo River — the old Zhuoshui River — runs along the edge of Tianwei, through Pitou and Erlin, and reaches the Taiwan Strait at Fusing. A plastic wrapper dropped into a drain here can be in the sea in a few days.
slides.body_zh: 東螺溪（舊濁水溪）沿著田尾鄉界流過，經過埤頭、二林，最後在福興鄉出海。在這裡掉進水溝的一個塑膠包裝，幾天後就可能在海裡。

slides.head_en: Taiwanese white dolphins are left in the world
slides.head_zh: 全世界的台灣白海豚，剩下不到 50 隻
slides.body_en: Fishers call them Matsu fish. They live only along Taiwan's west coast.
slides.body_zh: 漁民叫牠們「媽祖魚」，只住在台灣西海岸。
slides.ask_en: This school has more students than the world has white dolphins.
slides.ask_zh: 這所學校的學生，比全世界的白海豚還多。

slides.q_en: How much of the oxygen you are breathing right now came from the ocean?
slides.q_zh: 你現在呼吸的氧氣，有多少來自海洋？
slides.explain_en: Half. Every second breath you take was made by the sea.
slides.explain_zh: 一半。你每呼吸兩次，就有一次是海洋給的。

slides.head_en: tonnes of plastic enter the ocean every year
slides.head_zh: 每年有 800 萬噸塑膠進入海洋
slides.body_en: About one rubbish truck emptied into the sea every minute, all year.
slides.body_zh: 大約等於每分鐘一台垃圾車倒進海裡，全年無休。
slides.ask_en: Ships, or the land — where does most of it come from?
slides.ask_zh: 船上還是陸地？大部分是從哪裡來的？

slides.q_en: How long does a plastic bottle take to break down in the sea?
slides.q_zh: 一個塑膠瓶在海裡要多久才會分解？
slides.explain_en: About 450 years — and it never really vanishes. It just breaks into microplastic.
slides.explain_zh: 大約 450 年——而且它其實不會消失，只是碎成塑膠微粒。

slides.head_zh: 真的還假的？手比 ⭕ 或 ❌

items.en: Most ocean plastic comes from ships.
items.zh: 海洋裡的塑膠大多來自船隻。
items.note_en: Most of it comes from the land — through rivers and drains.
items.note_zh: 大部分來自陸地，經由河流和水溝流進海裡。

items.en: Fangyuan has the last and largest natural tidal flat in Taiwan.
items.zh: 芳苑有全台灣最後也最大的一片原始潮間帶。
items.note_en: It is in your county — and it is still working farmland for oysters.
items.note_zh: 就在你們縣內，而且到現在還是活生生的蚵田。

items.en: Microplastic has been found in the fish people eat.
items.zh: 人吃的魚身上已經驗出塑膠微粒。
items.note_en: What we throw into the sea comes back to our own plates.
items.note_zh: 我們丟進海裡的東西，會回到自己的餐盤上。

items.en: One school is too small to change anything.
items.zh: 一所學校太小，改變不了什麼。
items.note_en: Fangyuan's ox-cart oyster farming survives because local people refused to let it go.
items.note_zh: 芳苑的海牛採蚵能留到今天，就是因為在地人不肯放手。

slides.body_en: For sixty years, Fangyuan farmers have walked oxen onto the mudflat to harvest oysters. Machines took over. About twelve working oxen remain — the last place on Earth.
slides.body_zh: 六十年來，芳苑蚵農趕著黃牛走進潮間帶採蚵。機械取代之後，只剩約十二頭海牛——地球上最後一個。

slides.rule_en: In 30 seconds, shout out as many sea creatures in English as you can. I will count!
slides.rule_zh: 30 秒內，用英文喊出越多海洋生物越好，我來數！
slides.target_zh: 要打破的班級紀錄：18 個

slides.head_zh: 哪一件事對海洋幫助最大？
slides.sub_en: Rank these four from most helpful to least. Argue for your answer!
slides.sub_zh: 把這四件事從幫助最大排到最小。說出你的理由！

items.en: Picking up litter near your school drain
items.zh: 撿起學校水溝旁的垃圾

items.en: Getting your whole family to use one less plastic bag a day
items.zh: 讓全家每天少用一個塑膠袋

items.en: Telling ten people what you learned today
items.zh: 把今天學到的告訴十個人

slides.reveal_en: There is no single right answer — but the last two multiply. One person's habit becomes many.
slides.reveal_zh: 沒有標準答案——但後面兩個會「放大」。一個人的習慣會變成很多人的習慣。

slides.prompt_en: If the white dolphins disappear, what will Changhua have lost?
slides.prompt_zh: 如果白海豚消失了，彰化會失去什麼？
slides.sentence_en: If the dolphins disappear, Changhua will lose ______.
slides.sentence_zh: 如果白海豚消失了，彰化會失去 ______。
slides.time_en: One minute each. Then I will ask two of you.
slides.time_zh: 每人一分鐘。然後我會請兩位分享。

slides.note_en: Watch — then tell me the one thing you will protect.
slides.note_zh: 看完之後，告訴我你決定要保護的那一件事。

slides.head_en: 3 Things You Can Do This Week
slides.head_zh: 這週你可以做的 3 件事

items.en: Carry your own bottle and bag for one week.
items.zh: 帶自己的水壺和袋子，撐一個星期。

items.en: Pick up one piece of litter near a drain on your way home.
items.zh: 回家路上，在水溝旁撿起一件垃圾。

items.en: Ask your family to visit the Changhua coast — and see it for yourself.
items.zh: 跟家人提議去一趟彰化海邊，親眼看看。

items.en: The ocean gives me half my air.
items.zh: 海洋給了我一半的空氣。

items.en: The river carries what I drop.

slides.q_en: How much of the Earth's surface is ocean?
slides.q_zh: 地球表面有多少比例是海洋？
slides.explain_en: About 71%. We call it Earth — but it is mostly ocean.
slides.explain_zh: 大約 71%。我們叫它「地球」，但它其實大部分是海。

slides.body_en: Go to our School Tour page and find the Nanzhen Elementary column. No sign-up, no login — tell me what you will protect.
slides.body_zh: 到我們網站的 School Tour 頁面，找到南鎮國小那一欄，免註冊、免登入，告訴我你想保護什麼。

slides.big_en:
The ocean is not far away.
It is downstream.
